Title: Public preview: More preview enhancements for Azure Active Directory B2C

Body.Content:
A set of new features has been added to Azure Active Directory B2C, which is currently in preview.

The new features are:

  • Support for Microsoft account as a social identity provider (Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, and Amazon were already supported).
  • Unified sign-up or sign-in policy.
  • Self-service password reset policy.
  • Configurable token lifetimes, sessions, and single sign-on behavior.
  • Easy access to Azure AD B2C features on the Azure portal.

For more details, see More preview enhancements for Azure AD B2C.
